newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered up on Schroders upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered up on Schroders upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Standard Chartered Bank jumped in late trading on Thursday as Schroders Securities upgraded the stock to a "strong buy" from a "buy."
At 1456 GMT, the shares were up 19p to 866p.
In a review of the UK bank sector, Schroders said it was bullish on Standard Chartered's growth prospects, even as its costs rise in 1997.
The brokerage also upgraded Lloyds TSB Group to a "strong buy" from "buy," citing growth in its mortgage business.
Schroders also cut its rating on National Westminster Bank Plc and Royal Bank of Scotland to "sell" from "hold."
NatWest shares sank 5-1/2p to 670-1/2p, while shares in Royal Bank of Scotland dipped 1/2p to 530-1/2p.
